messages:
Asha Patel: Quick heads-up — Alameda Pharma (account: alameda-pharma) just signaled expansion. They're adding 3 new teams and want an onboarding + throughput plan for a clinical summarization workflow. Asking for capacity guidance and an enablement playbook.
Liam Chen: Thanks Asha. Do we have any recent usage numbers from them? Is this headed toward Dedicated or still hosted?
Asha Patel: They're currently on hosted and near the upper quartile of their free tier. Riley (customer) said they want predictable latency for clinical summaries, so likely leaning Dedicated or Reserved bursts.
Riley Gomez: Hi — Riley from Alameda. Confirming: three teams (research, medops, integrations). Expected initial concurrency ~60 reqs/s at peak, avg payload ~400 tokens, bursty during end-of-day reports. Target SLO p95 latency ~200ms for short summaries. Interested in a canary rollout for the medops team first.
Marco Rivera: @Liam and @Asha I can draft a short onboarding playbook + a canary runbook. Suggestion: start with a Dedicated small pool (2-4 GPUs) with autoscale burst to handle peak, enable prefix caching for repeated patient templates. I'll include batching and quantization options.
Liam Chen: Sounds good. Riley — any compliance concerns (PII, PHI) for Private deployment? That affects timeline.
Riley Gomez: We'll need HIPAA-safe handling. For now access will be via hosted but behind a VPN/proxy; long-term we'd consider Private/VPC. Could you include key management steps?
Asha Patel: Noted on HIPAA. This raises renewal importance — they're 6 months from renewal and expansion increases upside but also support risk if latency slips. I'll flag renewal manager.
Marco Rivera: Draft plan I'll include: (1) onboarding workshop schedule, (2) dedicated capacity sizing, (3) a health-check checklist, (4) playbook docs + sample prompt sets. Also add an eval harness for quality regressions.
Asha Patel: Can we get an estimate for cost delta for Dedicated vs hosted with autoscale? Riley wants ballpark numbers before the execs meet.
Marco Rivera: Ballpark: Dedicated small (2x A100 equiv) baseline ~ $18k/mo reserved, autoscale bursts add variable spend — estimate +20-40% depending on burst. Hosted w/ higher tier + caching might be cheaper short-term (~$6-9k/mo) but less predictable. I'll run numbers with current token estimates (they mentioned ~1.2M tokens/day).
DevOps Bot: Deploy-check: linked runbook template: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/onboarding-playbook — recommended sections: network/KMS, canary metrics, rollback criteria.
Liam Chen: Next steps: Marco to draft playbook and cost estimate, Asha to schedule enablement workshop with Riley, and CS to flag renewal manager for Q3 check-in. Who owns follow-up?
Asha Patel: I'll own customer coordination and renewal flag. Marco owns the technical plan and cost estimate. Riley — when's good for a 60-min workshop next week?
Riley Gomez: Monday or Wednesday AM PT works. Prefer Monday if that's available. Also can we get a short template for prompts and test data formats?
Marco Rivera: I'll attach a sample prompts pack and a small eval suite in the playbook. Expect a draft by EOD two business days.
Asha Patel: Great — I'll create a calendar invite and add renewal manager. Marking as "actionable": draft playbook, cost estimate, workshop invite.
Liam Chen: Thanks all — this looks like a high-opportunity expansion with some compliance caveats. Will monitor for any blocking infra requests.
Riley Gomez: Appreciate the quick responses. Looking forward to the workshop. :+1:
Marco Rivera: I'll post the draft here when ready and tag @Riley.
DevOps Bot: Incident note: none. No current alerts for alameda-pharma cluster.
Asha Patel: Closing loop for now — will update thread after workshop scheduling and when Marco posts the playbook.
